response.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_line_item_count FROM per_item;

assumptions.assumption: A derived_total_cost of zero makes the ratio undefined, so it is treated as a missing ratio and skipped (via NULLIF) instead of raising a divide-by-zero error.
Invoice line items are matched to order items only by order_item_id, which is the foreign key to Order_Items.
